title: [Bug] Monitor tool missing from Claude Code v2.1.104 despite documentation stating it exists
body:
**Bug Description**

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: ghostty
- Version: 2.1.104
- Feedback ID: 19527a66-0dbd-428b-b894-ecf0dceccfc3
